title: Low-Glycemic Causa Rolls with Peruvian Snappy Sauce
description: A unique twist on traditional causa rolls, incorporating Peruvian snappy sauce and low-glycemic ingredients for a healthier take. Perfect for a Japanese-inspired meal.
instructions: Cook sushi rice according to Japanese standards.
Grill salmon fillets, seasoning with Japanese flavors and cooking to a safe internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Slice the grilled salmon into thin strips.
Prepare Peruvian snappy sauce according to package instructions.
Mix low-glycemic soy sauce with lime juice for a marinade.
Combine cooked sushi rice with marinade and mix well.
Assemble causa rolls by spreading sushi rice mixture onto the center of the causa package.
Place grilled salmon strips on top of the rice mixture.
Fold the causa package to enclose the filling and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Slice causa rolls into individual servings and garnish with sliced avocado, chopped green onions, and a drizzle of Peruvian snappy sauce.
